title: Implement collectibles, rewards, and power-ups
description: Add collectible coins (scattered throughout levels, +10 XP each), gems (rare, +50 XP), and power-up items: speed boost (temporary 1.5x speed), shield (absorbs one hit), and magnet (attracts nearby coins). Each collectible should have a pixel-art sprite and a pickup animation (scale + fade). Track total coins collected per run. Dependencies: Task 3
